complaint.transcript: The vehicle lost power again after several repair attempts. The issue remains unresolved and affects normal use. I want to return the vehicle under the 3R policy.
complaint.scanSummary: Written complaint records repeated power loss, three repair visits and a formal Buyback request.

objective: Determine 3R scope and Buyback conditions, then assess the customer remedy and internal BMW/dealer allocation separately.

agents.name: Customer Care
agents.task: Plan the review, coordinate work and consolidate the applicability and Buyback recommendation

agents.name: Warranty Agent
findings: Repair count alone does not meet the more-than-four condition

agents.name: Technical Service Agent
agents.task: Retrieve the TSARA result and establish fault origin
findings: Fault persists after repeated repair attempts

agents.name: Case Knowledge Agent
findings: Comparable cost items normalized for review

recommendation.title: Likely Eligible for Buyback · Human Decision Required
reasons: TSARA confirms an unresolved serious safety-performance fault
Three visits are not used as the standalone threshold
Internal cost allocation is assessed separately from customer entitlement
